facts.fact: SENUM SA (Senegal) and SMTD-SA (Mali) inaugurated the interconnection of their national fibre-optic backbones at the Kidira-Diboli border bridge on Monday 2026-10-05, described by a speaker as the putting into service of the infrastructure; no capacity or traffic figure is given.

systems.country_label: interconnexion des backbones du Senegal et du Mali
